title: B1 fix has NO test pin — the exact bug fixed (https://https:// email CTA) would regress silently; new notification tests assert type/body only
evidence: `let origin = row.origin_domain` — new tests only assert `notification_type_for(db, row_id) |> should.equal("reference_completed")` and body copy; the CTA URL lives solely in the Resend payload (email_client.build_entity_url), which no test reads.
detail: Coverage NONE for B1: a revert to origin_from_domain would pass every delta test. Code-level fix verified by reading (build_entity_url prepends https://), risk low, but the regression is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Accept (email payload not testable without SMTP mock), or pin via a unit test on build_entity_url with a raw origin_domain input.

title: W2 decline_reason truncation has NO test pin — no test POSTs a >200-char reason; slice(0,200) is code-verified only
evidence: `|> string.slice(0, 200)` — grep of server/test shows no decline POST carrying a long decline_reason; existing decline tests (timing_fields only) never exercise the truncation branch.
detail: Coverage NONE for W2. A crafted long reason would fail closed (untruncated PII-length reason persisted) without any test catching it. Cheap to pin: POST decline with 250-char reason, assert result JSONB decline_reason length.
recommended_fix: Add one integration assertion: POST /decline with 250-char reason; assert stored result->>'decline_reason' is 200 chars.
